caption: The drawing consists of a black line illustration on a beige background, depicting an ornamental iron urn holder. The main object is a decorative bracket featuring an elaborate design with flowing scrollwork and a figure resembling a winged cherub or angel, whose arms extend forward to support the bracket. Attached to the ornate bracket is a round, horizontally placed platform with a scalloped or ribbed edge, intended to hold an urn; the diameter of the platform is labeled as 6½ inches. The bracket’s overall width from the far left, including the cherub's wing, to the outer edge of the platform is labeled as 16½ inches, and the height from the bottom curve to the top of the cherub’s wing is labeled as 9 inches. There is also a rectangular inset illustration in the lower right corner, showing the urn holder installed on the exterior wall of a building, under an overhanging roof, with the sky and foliage in the background. The title "ORNAMENTAL IRON URN HOLDER" is printed in uppercase letters below the main drawing.
title: Cast Iron Urn Holder
